name: planet
summary: The planet's own atmosphere, the one outdoor cells relax toward: gases, pressure, temperature and its parts, the day's range, sea, clouds and ice caps, and the starting air. Read only.

help.text: Before a world is loaded it answers only loaded false and terraforming_mod. Then: loaded, world_time_s, day_length_s, volumes, cells (outdoor 2 m cells), size_ratio, moles and litres, sea, pressure_kpa, game_pressure_kpa, temperature_k, sun, storm, gases, reservoirs, starting_air and terraforming_mod.

temperature.text: temperature_parts {sun_angle_k, sun_distance_k, greenhouse_k, density_k, weather_k, latent_k, external_k}; sun_angle_deg; solar_energy_percent; range {today_min_k, today_min_sun_angle_deg, today_max_k, today_max_sun_angle_deg, orbit_min_k, orbit_max_k}: the game's own formula swept over every sun angle.

gases.text: gases [{gas, display_name, state, amount_mol, per_cell_mol, partial_kpa, freezes_below_k, min_liquid_pressure_kpa, condenses_below_today_coldest_k, condenses_below_orbit_coldest_k}]. oxygen_kpa, toxins_kpa (human toxins), fuel_mol and oxidiser_mol (fire risk outdoors), carbon_dioxide_ratio. sea {liquid_l, threshold_l (where the sea is drawn), shown}. reservoirs {liquid_clouds, ice_clouds, ice_caps}, each null or {volume_l, liquid_l, amount_mol, contents}.

terraforming.text: starting_air: the air this world ships with at the planet's present size, the baseline Terraforming Reloaded measures from {per_cell_mol, mol, gases}. terraforming_mod: null, or Terraforming Reloaded's {name, version, state, live, temperature_adjustment_k}.
